connect.title: Zua a LinkedIn
connect.intro: Nyôr ken akaa a LinkedIn a a nengen sha akaa a u eren tom a mi la. Leadrat ka a ôr akaa a u nger sha kwagh u advertisement la tseegh, Lead Gen Form leads man advertisement la, shi a tindi a mba ve gem ishima la.
connect.need1: Ior mba ve lu a ityom i eren ken akaa a i yer ér LinkedIn (Viewer shin mba ve hembe nahan la).
connect.need2: Ior mba ve lu a ityom i eren sha peeji u kômpeni u i zough a mi la (Or u hemen, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Or u nengen sha akaa shin Or u tôvon sha akaa) - LinkedIn gba u una pase mba ve lu hemen la.
connect.need3: Mpin u sha namba u telefon sha Lead Gen Forms wou - mbahemenev mba ve lu a namba u telefon ga yô, a kera seer ve ga.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Tese LinkedIn wer ka an nan lu mbahemenev mba nan hingir mba ve lu a ishimaverenkeghen i mimi yô. Shighe u or u nan lu hemen LinkedIn nan zough a mlu u u tsough shin heen ne yô, Leadrat ka a ôr kwagh u nan hen LinkedIn , nahan ripoti you i campaign la i tese mlu u or u nan lu hemen la shi LinkedIn una zua a ior kpishi mba ve lu er mbahemenev ou mba hemban doon cii nahan yô. Ka ID u or u hemen LinkedIn la tseegh i tindi a mi ye.
